verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server for Raygun, published under its parent organization's GitHub (MindscapeHQ/mcp-server-raygun), so an agent can connect to Raygun directly. The evidence is a single probe line, and the server is backed by Raygun's documented v3 API. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the server's tools/capabilities and setup or auth flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
